summary: Frontend-only verification of Goorin B2B Ops checkout address flows (edit, cancel, new address, validation) and Marketplace sidebar active-state during checkout. All 7 review-request checks passed at 1500px desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar nav items lack data-testid attributes (nav-marketplace etc.) — required by review-request spec. Testing had to fall back to text-based selectors and DOM class inspection. Add data-testid to /app/frontend/src/App.tsx nav buttons.
Toasts DOM contains duplicated/empty entries (each toast text queried 3-6 times) — likely from nested containers or duplicated toast portals; consider deduping in the Toast provider.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) checkout-page visible; (2) Marketplace .nav-item has 'active' class while on /checkout; (3) address-edit opens form with header 'Edit address', addr-name prefilled 'Ryan Mirabile', addr-save='Save changes'; saving updates card in-place, closes form, toast 'Address updated' shown; (4) Cancel discards changes; (5) address-new opens empty form with 'New address' + 'Save address', empty-save shows error toast 'Please fill in Full name, Address, City, State, ZIP' and form stays; filling all fields creates 2nd address-saved card with aria-checked=true, form closes; (6) addr-cancel & addr-save both 42px tall aligned at same y; (7) Continue to payment advances to Step 3 with Test User ship-to address.
rca of the issue: N/A — all bug fixes verified working.
